episodes.title: Our Cup Runneth Over
episodes.summary: After losing their fortune, the Rose family must relocate to their last remaining asset - a small town Johnny once bought as a joke.

episodes.title: The Drip
episodes.summary: Johnny must get permission to sell the town from its Mayor, Roland Schitt. David and Alexis spend a night out with the locals.

episodes.title: Don't Worry, It's His Sister
episodes.summary: Johnny tries to get a potentially offensive town sign taken down, while David is faced with the frightening task of finding a job.

episodes.title: Bad Parents
episodes.summary: Johnny and Moira, feeling like they have failed as parents, try to get to know their grown children. Alexis spies on Mutt and thinks he's having an affair with the Mayor's wife.

episodes.title: The Cabin
episodes.summary: Looking for privacy, Johnny and Moira take the Mayor up on his offer of using his cabin for a night, while Alexis and David use the opportunity to throw a party.

episodes.title: Wine and Roses
episodes.summary: Moira is hired to be a local winery's spokesperson; David struggles with a health problem.

episodes.title: Turkey Shoot
episodes.summary: Following an incident where David is unable to kill an insect in his room, Stevie, as a joke, invites David along on Roland's annual turkey shoot.

episodes.title: Allez-Vous
episodes.summary: Moira and David try to earn money by selling cosmetics to the locals, while Johnny heads to Elmdale in hopes of collecting unemployment insurance.

episodes.title: Carl's Funeral
episodes.summary: Johnny reluctantly agrees to speak at the funeral of a local man he doesn't really know. Alexis struggles with her new boyfriend's love of animals.

episodes.title: Honeymoon
episodes.summary: Johnny and Moira go to Roland's Hawaiian party; Alexis and Ted host a dinner party; David and Stevie's relationship heats up.

episodes.title: Little Sister
episodes.summary: Moira's estranged sister, Deedee, pays an unexpected visit, while David agrees to talk with one of Jocelyn's students about being "different".

episodes.title: Surprise Party
episodes.summary: Johnny tries to arrange a surprise birthday party for Moira. Things backfire when Moira, unwittingly, takes over the planning of her own party.

episodes.title: Town for Sale
episodes.summary: Johnny finds a potential buyer for the town; David and Alexis realize they have become attached to Schitt's Creek.

episodes.title: Finding David
episodes.summary: While the family searches for the missing David, Alexis takes her relationship with Mutt to the next level while technically engaged to Ted.

episodes.title: Family Dinner
episodes.summary: David helps Moira cook dinner. Johnny looks for an office for his consulting business and Alexis comes clean with Ted about their engagement.

episodes.title: Jazzagals
episodes.summary: Moira tries to join the town's a capella group, Alexis enjoys her latest relationship and Johnny attempts to help out at Bob's Garage.

episodes.title: Estate Sale
episodes.summary: Johnny and Moira go to an estate sale. Mutt surprises Alexis with a bike, while Roland asks David to help him shop for a special item.

episodes.title: Bob's Bagels
episodes.summary: Johnny talks himself into an unlikely business partnership with Bob. David gets an interview at a woman's clothing store while Moira reluctantly cares for an ailing Alexis.

episodes.title: Moira vs. Town Council
episodes.summary: Moira tries to beautify the town. David misuses the company credit card. A grooming misstep forces Alexis and Mutt to question their relationship.

episodes.title: The Candidate
episodes.summary: Johnny contemplates running for Town Council. David and Stevie look for love in all the wrong places while Alexis comes to terms with single life.

episodes.title: Milk Money
episodes.summary: Alexis accidentally gets Johnny into the raw milk business. Moira tries to connect with the townsfolk. And David gives style advice to the competition without fully considering the consequences.

episodes.title: Moira's Nudes
episodes.summary: Moira is worried that racy photos from her past will jeopardize the campaign; Johnny asks for financial help; Alexis gets a job.

episodes.title: Ronnie's Party
episodes.summary: Johnny and Moira, on the campaign trail, meet with a key demographic. Alexis struggles in her new job. David offers awkward emotional support to his boss' 14-year-old daughter.

episodes.title: The Motel Guest
episodes.summary: Johnny and Moira have a surprise guest, David and Alexis look for an apartment.

episodes.title: Lawn Signs
episodes.summary: Some of Moira's lawn signs disappear; David and Alexis work to get David's boss out of trouble.

episodes.title: Happy Anniversary
episodes.summary: Johnny and Moira go out for their anniversary and run into a couple they knew from their former life, while Alexis and David attend Mutt's annual barn party, making up with some friends, and making out with others.

episodes.title: Opening Night
episodes.summary: Johnny struggles to find a new purpose, while Moira must confront the harsh realities of local politics.

episodes.title: The Throuple
episodes.summary: David and Stevie must come to terms with their new relationship, while Alexis and Moira become anxious when they schedule a rare mother/daughter lunch.

episodes.title: New Car
episodes.summary: Johnny and Moira feign poverty in an attempt to get a deal on a used car, while David helps Stevie lay her great-aunt to rest.

episodes.title: Driving Test
episodes.summary: Johnny and Moira become concerned about the future of the motel, while David panics in anticipation of having to re-take his driving test.

episodes.title: Rooms by the Hour
episodes.summary: Johnny puts the motel in an awkward position after renting rooms to a morally dubious enterprise, while David helps Moira tape a film audition.

episodes.title: Murder Mystery
episodes.summary: Johnny and Stevie pitch a nearby golf course on a package deal with the motel. Moira tries to get out of an invitation to Twyla's murder mystery party.

episodes.title: General Store
episodes.summary: David plans a new business venture, while Alexis adjusts to her first day at school.

episodes.title: Motel Review
episodes.summary: David meets a new friend while setting up his business, Johnny defends Alexis's schoolwork, and Moira deals with a difficult guest at the motel.

episodes.title: The Affair
episodes.summary: Moira and Roland find themselves in a compromising situation. Alexis drives a wedge between David and Patrick.

episodes.title: Sebastien Raine
episodes.summary: David's photographer ex-boyfriend arrives in town to do a photo series on Moira. Johnny and Roland suspect that Bob is cheating at poker.

episodes.title: Stop Saying Lice!
episodes.summary: Johnny tries to stop the spread of lice. Moira tries to get out of having a garden named after her.

episodes.title: Friends and Family
episodes.summary: Johnny and Moira struggle to find a place for their family portrait. David hosts a "soft launch" of his new store.

episodes.title: Grad Night
episodes.summary: Johnny and Stevie celebrate their first fully booked motel. David goes on a date with Patrick.

episodes.title: Dead Guy in Room 4
episodes.summary: While Moira fears she is responsible for the death of a motel guest, David and Patrick decide to make their budding romance official.

episodes.title: Pregnancy Test
episodes.summary: After finding a positive pregnancy test, Johnny braces himself for the possibility of a new baby in the family, while David and Patrick search for some privacy.

episodes.title: Asbestos Fest
episodes.summary: Moira prepares for her headline debut at the annual Schitt's Creek Asbestos Fest, while David deals with a group of loitering teens in the apothecary.

episodes.title: Girls' Night
episodes.summary: Alexis and Twyla have a girls' night out. Patrick teaches David about compromise.

episodes.title: RIP Moira Rose
episodes.summary: A rumour of Moira's death surfaces online. Roland asks Johnny to be godfather to his child.

episodes.title: Open Mic
episodes.summary: David and Patrick throw an open mic to promote their shop and David gets nervous when Patrick states he will be performing. Johnny and Alexis rebrand the motel, but Stevie fears they are over-expanding. Moira tries to keep secret the gender of the Schitts' new baby.

episodes.title: The Barbecue
episodes.summary: As the Roses plan a family barbecue, David is forced to test the limits of his comfort level with Patrick, while Alexis investigates a mysterious text from Ted.

episodes.title: The Jazzaguy
episodes.summary: After the barbecue fiasco, Stevie takes David to a spa for some consoling. Johnny impresses the Jazzagals with his talents, but Moira doesn't like his joining the group. Alexis tries out a dating app.

episodes.title: The Olive Branch
episodes.summary: David realizes he may have dragged out his time apart from Patrick too long and looks for a way to reconcile, while Moira pitches a Singles Week event at Town Hall. Johnny buys Stevie a gift for her help at the motel.

episodes.title: Baby Sprinkle
episodes.summary: Johnny and Moira attend a singles event as research, but find themselves getting overly involved. Alexis runs into an old friend in town. David agrees to help Jocelyn in planning her baby shower.

episodes.title: The Rollout
episodes.summary: Moira struggles to get out of jury duty, while David tries to minimize the damage of a potentially harmful Rose Apothecary product.

episodes.title: Singles Week
episodes.summary: Singles Week gets underway just as Jocelyn's baby arrives, and Patrick takes his relationship with David to the next level.

episodes.title: The Crowening
episodes.summary: While Moira is in Bosnia filming the Crows movie that she hopes will revive her acting career, David attempts to take his relationship with Patrick to new heights.

episodes.title: Love Letters
episodes.summary: A sleep-deprived Moira worries about a stack of old love letters addressed to Johnny from another woman, while David and Stevie are held up at David's store.

episodes.title: The Plant
episodes.summary: Alexis and Johnny hatch a plan to impress a motel reviewer, while David and Patrick search for a new apartment.

episodes.title: The Dress
episodes.summary: Johnny finds himself under financial pressure with the arrival of Moira's high-priced red carpet gown for the Crows movie premiere. David is conned into taking a road trip with Stevie.

episodes.title: Housewarming
episodes.summary: David and Patrick throw a housewarming party and Ted finally lets loose, while Johnny and Moira try their best to babysit Roland Jr. for the evening.

episodes.title: Rock On!
episodes.summary: Moira and the Jazzagals take Jocelyn out for a night at the casino, while Johnny tries to navigate an awkward conversation with Stevie about intimacy in the workplace.

episodes.title: A Whisper of Desire
episodes.summary: Johnny suspects that Ted's mom is attracted to him, while Moira can't resist getting involved in a local musical production.

episodes.title: The Hospies
episodes.summary: Johnny and Stevie attend the regional hospitality awards, while Moira does everything in her power to stop Alexis from auditioning for Cabaret.

episodes.title: The M.V.P.
episodes.summary: David agrees to sub in for the annual baseball game, and Moira runs a rehearsal that pushes Stevie over the edge.

episodes.title: Roadkill
episodes.summary: Johnny and Moira's afternoon plans are interrupted when they accidentally hit a cat. David runs into an old colleague at the flea market whose new business bears a striking resemblance to Rose Apothecary.

episodes.title: Meet the Parents
episodes.summary: Patrick's parents are in town for his surprise party, but the parents end up with an even bigger surprise, while Alexis drags Moira to a soap opera convention.

episodes.title: The Roast
episodes.summary: Johnny fills in for Moira at the annual Mayor's Roast, as David distracts Moira from finding out that Stevie and Patrick have been taking private dance lessons.

episodes.title: The Hike
episodes.summary: Patrick tries to take David on a romantic hike, while Johnny has a health scare that sends everyone into a panic.

episodes.title: Life Is a Cabaret
episodes.summary: It's Opening Night for Cabaret, and Stevie is nowhere to be found. David tries to make a big announcement, but keeps getting overshadowed by the musical.

episodes.title: Smoke Signals
episodes.summary: David scouts a potential wedding venue, while Johnny and Moira have a romantic picnic by the creek.

episodes.title: The Incident
episodes.summary: David is embarrassed by a childhood issue that resurfaces, and only spirals further when Patrick is so understanding; Johnny, Stevie and Roland attend a viewing for a nearby motel; Alexis helps Moira join social media.

episodes.title: The Job Interview
episodes.summary: Johnny and Moira endeavor to secure an investor for a new motel, while Alexis and Ted struggle with long-distance.

episodes.title: Maid of Honour
episodes.summary: Moira shares the newly released Crows movie trailer with the Jazzagals. Johnny and Roland find a suspicious bag of money at the new motel.

episodes.title: The Premiere
episodes.summary: Alexis plans a local premiere for the Crows movie and Moira makes a big splash on the red carpet, while David tends to Patrick after his wisdom teeth removal.

episodes.title: The Wingman
episodes.summary: Alexis and Moira deal with the outcome of a viral video, while Johnny helps Bob get back out in the dating world.

episodes.title: Moira Rosé
episodes.summary: Moira and David sample wine at Herb Ertlinger's vineyard, while Johnny attempts to have "the talk" with Patrick.

episodes.title: The Presidential Suite
episodes.summary: Johnny and Moira spend a night at the presidential suite in the new motel, while Alexis receives a surprise visitor.

episodes.title: Rebound
episodes.summary: Johnny becomes overly involved in Alexis's romantic life, while Moira offends the townspeople in an interview with People magazine.

episodes.title: Sunrise, Sunset
episodes.summary: Moira's former "Sunrise Bay" producers show up with big news, while Alexis binge-watches old episodes of the soap.

episodes.title: The Bachelor Party
episodes.summary: The Roses attend the "Escape Room" portion of David and Patrick's Bachelor Party, but their participation wanes the more their personal dilemmas come to a head.

episodes.title: The Pitch
episodes.summary: Johnny, Stevie and Roland head to New York for their pitch meeting, while the family anxiously awaits their return.

episodes.title: Start Spreading the News
episodes.summary: Moira receives some unexpected news, and David makes a tough decision about where he wants to live.

episodes.title: Happy Ending
episodes.summary: David stresses out over the rain on his wedding day, but his family makes it right.
